name: cliniko-patients
description: Manage Cliniko patients, contacts, and referral sources

connection.instructions:
Connect with your **personal** Cliniko API key — it inherits your own Cliniko permissions.

1. In Cliniko, click your name (bottom-left) → **My Info**.
2. Scroll to **Manage API keys** and click **Add a key**.
3. Copy the key and paste it below.

Your key ends in a region suffix (e.g. `-au4`); we detect your data centre from it automatically.

fields.name: CLINIKO_API_KEY
fields.label: Cliniko API key
fields.helpText: Found under My Info → Manage API keys in Cliniko.
